data.name: Jalaal
data.gender_notes: Jalaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The radiant one, The one who shines with the light of Allah's greatness and power. The name Jalaal carries the meaning “Majesty, Splendor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Jalaal usually hope their child will grow to embody majesty, splendor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of the greatness and majesty of Allah
data.etymology: Jalaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majesty, Splendor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jalaal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جلال
in_arabic.meaning: عظمت و شان و منزلت، بزرگی و رفعت
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق از جَلَلَ يَجِلُّ جَلالاً وأَجلَلَ فهو جَلِيٌّ وجَلالٌ، ويُجلّ جَلّاً فتلك أَفعال مختلفة أَصلها واحد وهو الارتفاع والعلو، ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأعراف آية ٢٤٣ وسورة الزمر آية ٢٥، ويعني بالعظمة والكبرياء والجلال

in_urdu.name: جلال
in_urdu.long_meaning: جلال نام کی عظمت و شان، منزلت و بزرگی کا اظہار کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کی جڑ جَلَلَ ہے، معنی ہیں بلند ہونا، عظیم ہونا، اس نام کا ذکر اردو بولنے والے مسلمانوں میں بہت عام ہے

in_hindi.name: जलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: जलाल नाम का अर्थ महानता, शोभा और महत्व है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका मूल जَلَلَ है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचा होना, महान होना, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रचलित है

in_pashto.name: جلال
in_pashto.long_meaning: جلال نوم د عظمت او لوړوالی معنا لري، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د جَلَلَ ريښه لري، چې معنی یې لوړ هونا او عظیم هونا دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو ټولنو کې ډیر کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Jalaal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jalaal is derived from the Arabic root جَلَلَ, which means to rise, to be elevated, or to be great. It signifies glory, majesty, and greatness. In Islamic tradition, the name Jalaal is associated with one of the attributes of Allah, Al-Jalaal, which emphasizes His greatness and majesty. The name has been used throughout Islamic history and is found in various cultures across the Muslim world

Historically, there have been many significant figures in Islamic history with the name Jalaal, including scholars, soldiers, and rulers who have made significant contributions to the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jalaal represents the inner glow and radiance that comes from a deep connection with Allah. It is a reminder of the greatness and power of Allah, and the importance of striving to embody His qualities in our daily lives. The name Jalaal can be seen as a call to recognize and tap into the divine light within oneself, and to use it to serve and uplift others. In essence, Jalaal reflects the belief that each individual has the potential to shine brightly with the light of Allah's love and guidance.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jalaal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of majesty, splendor.
